title: chargehand run request, v1
description: What a caller sends to start a run. Intake turns it into a task-spec/v1.

interactive.description: false: never block on a question; return status needs_input instead.

verify.description: The command that verifies a change, as an argument vector, for a preset whose node writes. Absent: chargehand detects the repository's test command.

approved.description: true: run even if the preset's approval thresholds (risk, estimate) would stop it with needs_input.

path.description: Local checkout the worker runs in.

inputs.description: Caller-supplied facts. Claims cite them with evidence kind 'input' and locator = id.

driven.description: A batch of tasks run as driven sessions, one container each, ending in a draft pull request per task (ADR 0039). Needs context.repository and unique task ids; both are checked by the server, not by this schema (a schema rule that tightens a published contract would be a breaking change).

ref.description: A tracker item id, resolved through the profile's task source.

goal.description: Free text: what the change should do.

max_tokens_total.description: Input plus output tokens over the batch. Binds in both credential modes.

max_usd_total.description: Dollars over the batch; enforced only where the credential is priced (an API key).

draft_pr.description: Always true: pull requests are opened as drafts and never merged.

caller_blocks.description: Caller-owned prompt blocks. Placed in the task block and recorded in prompt_chain.

sha256.description: sha256 of the block's normalised UTF-8 bytes (LF line endings, no trailing whitespace).
